notes: §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2: report-name-1 "may be used only if the referenced report description contains: a. A CONTROL clause, and b. Not more than one detail report group, and c. At least one body group." BindGenerate's report-name arm refuses a report with no CONTROL clause (COBOL0899, every edition) and, gated on DialectLevel < 2002, one with more than one detail group (COBOL6823, citing the twin §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6); item c is ScreenReportGroupCensus's universal body-group refusal (COBOL2749), which 1985 also states for every report (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR7). Probed at 85: CONTROL K with one detail and a CF runs summary-only (CF-03, CF-02, no detail lines); no CONTROL clause COBOL0899 on each GENERATE RPT; two details COBOL6823 at 85 and accepted at 2002 (the 2002 lift); RH/PH only COBOL2749; CONTROL FINAL with only a CF FINAL, a CH only and a CF only (no detail) all run; GENERATE with no operand and with two report-names syntax errors; GENERATE DET OF RPT runs. Witness: GENERATE RPT on a report with no CONTROL clause is refused.

next.reason: 1985: "b. Not more than one detail report group, and"; 2023: "Report-name-1 may be used only if the referenced report description entry contains a CONTROL clause.". 2023 keeps the CONTROL clause condition, and every report must have a body group, but the one-detail-group limit is gone, so GENERATE report-name is allowed with several details.
